stateNotes.president|2000|FL: Florida's total is the certified canvass, Bush 2,912,790 to Gore 2,912,253 (537 votes). Its county returns add up to Gore by 202; the 2,450 certified votes they lack are in the state total only.

countyNotes.AK: Alaska reports presidential results by state house district, not by borough, so it has no county results; its districts count toward the state total.
